decision_rule: Consultation 20 constrained composition and the battery R3-R5 / poles R7 / DC R2-lines-A rules. A line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (re-post stamp as first-posted date; aggregator or expired copy as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count, leads with an older fact (opening lines only; includes a line that carries only an older fact while a newer stated fact drives the score, battery R3 Martin Energy precedent, counted form-only), carries pitch or Path claims, lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged; plants.csv must equal the evidence value (a blank plants.csv field is corrected with the evidence line as replacement, as DC-LA did; reported separately). 'listed <date>' for a board stamp is allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17). Ordering is not checked on bottleneck guesses. Unreachable only if a source cannot be reached at all.
method: Every job board behind a line re-read 2026-11-20: AAON Workday CXS; FTI and nVent Workday detail pages via headless browser (CXS API returned 429 for wd1/wd5); CPI Paycom job-map and job-posting-previews APIs plus detail JSON-LD; Rittal applytojob list and pages; JobTarget pages; WM UKG LoadSearchResults; careers.se.com API; G&W career-opportunities list and position pages; S&C Oracle requisition details and findReqs; QES AppOne company job-post API and posting API; IE Paylocity board pageData and detail JSON-LD; M.C. Dean jobs API. Every cited role is still listed. News, company and government quotes behind line facts re-checked fragment-wise against the live pages (AAON/BASX, NC Governor, WITN, Area Development x2, FTI x2, Opelika Observer, Olathe Chamber, REjournals, PR Newswire copy of S&C, WM news): all FOUND. No web searches used. No ledger or inbox file edited.
rate_note: 6/36 = 16.7% headline (all 36 text lines are on High or Medium plants); 2/36 = 5.6% excluding the 4 plants.csv merge faults (Fulton x2, Oshkosh x2, whose evidence text is correct); substantive 1/36 = 2.8% (G&W misdating only; Olathe is form-only ordering). No score moves.
repeated_kind: other x6; 4 of them one cause: plants.csv opening_line/bottleneck_guess blank while evidence.csv carries the line (Central Electric Fulton x2, nVent Oshkosh x2; blank since profiler-A merge dd9e0a4). DC-LA found the same on 8 plants / 15 lines vertical-wide (these four included). validate_lines.py --vertical falls back to the last evidence row when plants.csv matches none, so it never catches a blank map field. Sweep: copy the evidence lines into plants.csv and make the validator fail on a blank or mismatched plants.csv field.
